visualCharacteristics.purpose: Scored multi-question knowledge quiz shown one question at a time, with per-answer feedback and a final score
visualCharacteristics.layout: pale green rounded panel; start screen with large centred navy title and navy Start pill; question screens with a counter, a white card of radio answers, feedback with the chosen answer's explanation and a Continue/Next pill; result screen with score, message and Restart pill

contentPattern.structure: optional key | value config rows (Title, Intro, Start label, Continue label, Next label, Counter, Correct label, Incorrect label, Multiple label, Result, Complete message, Restart label); a "Questions" row; then question | option | correct (true/false) | explanation rows (question text only on the first row of each question, following rows leave cell 1 empty). Templates use {n}, {total} and {score} placeholders
contentPattern.sourceDescription: Obesity and heart health quiz: start screen "Obesity and heart health" with "Start Quiz" button, 10 multiple-choice questions with a "Question N of 10" counter, explanation after each answer, score at the end

reuseGuidance: Use for scored quizzes with right and wrong answers. Use quiz-poll for single opinion questions without a correct answer. All labels are authored so the block can be localised without code changes. Fires a "quiz:completed" event on window with { score, total }.
